title: Russia trip that fell through and returning America's kindness
summary: He says he was slated to go to Russia with Ed Sullivan but missed it, will go anywhere Joe Glaser sends him, and feels he owes America.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: You've been over there in Russia? I've been to Russia, yeah. I was slated to go to Russia with Ed Sullivan the week we played in Spileto. But I ate too much spaghetti one night and I'd stay there a week. You're going to go to Russia? I'll go anywhere. Just do it. Anywhere Joe Glazer sent me. I'll go. I mean, I just want to go to Holland.

Louie, do you feel that one of the reasons you're doing this is that America has been very good to you and you want to return? That's right. Back to return is when I just finished paying for my house. You better go back here. Yeah, I don't know another place. This is kind of a personal question, but what do you think are some of the faults that you have?
